subject: Re: PO routing, remit disaggregation & self-bill exclusion request
messages:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@blueridge-logistics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, AP Team <ap@blueridge-logistics.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:12:00 +0200
Subject: PO routing question & self-bill exclusion

Hi Kimberly,

Quick question as we're starting the onboarding packet for Redwood: our AP system (BRL Pay) requires a remit disaggregation when a single invoice covers services billed to multiple legal entities. For Redwood, do you have separate legal-entity invoices (multiple remit-to locations) or should we accept a single invoice with line-level PO mapping?

Also, historically some vendors are onboarded for "self-billing" where we auto-generate supplier invoices. Legal wants to exclude the following vendors from self-bill because of VAT evidence complexity — can Redwood be excluded from BRL's self-bill program? If yes, we'll mark you as "manual invoice only" and proceed with the standard AP packet.

I've attached our AP onboarding packet and a sample stub CSV for self-bill exclusions.

Thanks,
Elena Rossi
Head of Supplier Operations
Blue Ridge Logistics
Attachments: BRL_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf, sample_self_bill_stub.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@blueridge-logistics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO routing question & self-bill exclusion

Elena —

Thanks for the packet, and for flagging the self-bill item. Short answers:
- We can accept a single invoice that contains line-level PO mapping back to BRL's multiple legal entities (we'll include company code on each line).
- We can be excluded from self-bill — Legal prefers that we remain on manual invoices for EU VAT reconciliation unless the customer provides detailed tax IDs per remit location.

To get this across the line we'll need:
1) A mapping table of BRL legal entities -> remit-to account numbers (your side) so our AP/finance can map line items automatically.
2) Confirmation of the PO format (will the PO include a company_code field or do we need to parse the shipping/line addresses?).
3) Signed AP packet acceptance (I can get this routed to Procurement/Legal).

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the invoice template fields we require and whether our billing system can emit line-level company_code? If you want, I can attach the BRL packet into our DocuSign flow once we confirm fields.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO routing question & self-bill exclusion

On Thu, Jun 10, 2026 at 09:45 AM Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com> wrote:
> Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm the invoice template fields we require and whether our billing system can emit line-level company_code?

We can do company_code at the line level; our billing pipeline supports a freeform metadata column that we can populate with BRL's remit ID. Two implementation notes:

- If BRL sends a single invoice covering multiple legal entities we'll need the seller VAT number per remit line to complete EU VAT validation. Without per-line VAT we won't be able to apply reverse-charge or split VAT correctly.
- For the self-bill exclusion: Legal (Naomi) will need to sign off on an exclusion clause in the AP packet. Naomi, can you confirm the required wording? I suggest: "Vendor to be excluded from Blue Ridge Logistics self-billing program; vendor will issue invoices and provide VAT evidence per remit location."

I can prepare an example invoice sample (CSV) with line-level company_code and vendor-supplied VAT columns for BRL to validate. Kimberly, once we have their mapping table we can push a UAT invoice through our sandbox (BILLING-SBX) so BRL can confirm auto-mapping.

- Marissa

Attachments referenced: sample_invoice_redwood_linecode.csv

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@blueridge-logistics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: Blue Ridge Logistics AP <ap@blueridge-logistics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 15:44:00 +0200
Subject: Re: PO routing question & self-bill exclusion

Kimberly / team —

Appreciate the quick answers and the proposed path. Confirming next steps from BRL:
1) We'll provide the legal-entity -> remit-account CSV by end of day tomorrow (includes remit account, VAT id, company_code field).
2) We will mark Redwood as "manual invoice only" in the self-bill stub and sign the clause below.

Signed clause to include in AP packet (accepted by BRL legal):
"Blue Ridge Logistics will not apply automatic self-billing to Redwood Inference for the identified legal entities. Redwood Inference will submit invoices and provide VAT evidence for each remit location as required under EU tax regulations."

I've attached the completed BRL_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf with the clause filled and a sample of our remit-account mapping. Please confirm receipt and we'll schedule a 30-minute UAT on June 18 to run one sample invoice through the mapping.

Thanks,
Elena
Attachments: BRL_AP_Onboarding_Packet_v3.pdf (completed), remit_mapping_redwood.csv
